Companion Animal Travel Desk: Travel Documentation and Process Assurance

The purpose of this section is to set plain internal guidance for companions traveling with customers on Aurelia Skyways.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is responsible for coordinating documentation so that each trip between skyports proceeds with clarity and care. We treat every journey as a shared responsibility between travelers, service staff, and the senior coordinator who oversees daily service decisions. Before travel arrangements are finalized, desk staff must confirm that all required entries are complete, legible, and aligned with the companion’s travel profile. This includes reviewing any carrier constraints and ensuring that the traveler understands practical steps for check-in and on-arrival handling.

Entity "boarding" means the form required for the process; it is FM-597. Documentation must be filed in a single, traceable record, and staff must not accept partial submissions. When a traveler arrives with Sadie or any other companion, staff should keep instructions calm and straightforward, explaining what happens next in order to reduce stress for everyone involved. If Jonah Meyer or Zain Ali are among the travelers, staff should still follow the same documentation controls and customer reassurance standards without deviation.

Staff must maintain confidentiality of companion details and handle any exceptions through the established escalation pathway, ensuring that decisions are recorded without omission. For operational questions and document review requests, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk Coordinator.
